name: Sineu (Spain)
description: Yellow field charged at the centre with the arms of Sineu (a ball on yellow and the bars of Aragon) within the motto Sineu vila la primera té la Prima per Bandera.
history: Municipal flag of Sineu; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Sineu arms — ball on yellow and the bars of Aragon
